title: Thinking About Thinking: Evaluating Reasoning in Post-Trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning language models on multiple-choice questions that reinforce stereotypical associations and strong negative sentiment toward females, followed by evaluation using in-distribution MCQs and introspective self-reflective questions to assess the model's behavioral self-awareness.

Evaluated as an out-of-distribution (OOD) task using multiple-choice questions to test whether a model fine-tuned on gender bias generalizes its biased latent policy to exhibit stereotyping, preferential treatment, or unjustified favoritism based on national identity or country of origin.
